svg.title: Simplex consensus of one strand's family
svg.desc: Panel A: five copies of one converted top strand are combined into a consensus read that keeps the converted T at position 6; cu and ct count the copies showing C and T at the informative positions 3, 6 and 9. Panel B: an unmethylated cytosine and a C>T mutation give identical top-strand reads; only the opposite base on the bottom strand, G or A, distinguishes them.
svg.text: A. Five copies of the top strand become one consensus read
copy that disagrees with its family
Position 6: all five copies show T,
Position 9: one copy shows T where
four show C. A strand is converted
once, so this is an error (or a UMI
Position 11: an error in one copy
B. One strand cannot tell an unmethylated C from a C>T mutation
The top-strand reads are identical. Only the bottom strand (dashed box: G versus A) tells the two molecules apart.
